newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: HP invests S$40 mln in handheld computing.
newsitem.headline: HP invests S$40 mln in handheld computing.

text.p: Hewlett-Packard Co (HP) said on Tuesday it would investg Singapore $40 million over five years in Singapore in research and development (R&D) in handheld computing products.
The programme by HP Singapore's Asia Pacific Personal Computer Division is supported by a grant from the National Science and Technology Board, HP said in a statement.
It did not say how much the grant was worth.
In Singapore, HP undertakes R&D, designs, makes and markets handheld computing products for the worldwide market.
